messages.subject: Re: Non-Ascii in SelectInput
parts:
Hi,

thank you for your help. You helped me solve at least part of the problem.

1. It doesn't work with copy&paste into RStudio by default. You have to change the default encoding.
2. If I c&p into notepad++ and manually set the encoding of the r-file to UTF-8 it works.
3. If I use strings from a R variable it doesn't work, no matter the encoding.

e.g. 

> x<-enc2utf8("Brütal")
> x
[1] "Brütal"
> Encoding(x)
[1] "UTF-8"
> runApp("/Shinytest")

(I just replaced the two instances of Brütal in your code with x)

Steve

Unfortunately no change.

But, something I probably should have tried 3 replies ago:

1. RStudio also doesn't display the content of x correctly. R output/input does, but the workspace viewer doesn't.

b. If the RStudio editor is set to UTF-8 it displays correctly in R but is borked in Shiny and the workspace viewer.
